top_categories.workout_context: 75ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
GFNY Ventura's long coastal-and-mountain loop forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 87 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Ventura's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
At GFNY Ventura, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Ventura. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 87, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
6,499ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
6,499ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At GFNY Ventura, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on long coastal-and-mountain loop. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 87 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 6,499ft of climbing on long coastal-and-mountain loop does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GFNY Ventura’s 87 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at GFNY Ventura requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on long coastal-and-mountain loop to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Road Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 87 miles of long coastal-and-mountain loop in Ventura, California, USA.
